parts:
Coding the Model in Stan

The Stan program for the change point model is shown in Figure 12.1. The transformed
parameter lp[s] stores the quantity log p„s;Dje; l….
Although the model in Figure 12.1 is easy to undertand, <- (s) missing.

Cheers.
